### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A26, A27 and A28 each occurred in about 100% of traces (mean occurrences per trace ≈ 1.0). In the later window, each occurs in about 1.5% of traces (mean ≈ 0.015). [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007]
- In the earlier window, activities A19, A20 and A21 were nearly absent (participation 2%, 1.5% and 1% respectively). In the later window, they occur in about 30%, 32.5% and 37.5% of traces respectively. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- Activity A10 increased from about 13.5% to 22.5% trace participation. [OCC001]
- The outgoing transitions of A19, A20 and A21 changed: before they went to A11, A34, A39 and similar; in the later window about 95% of their outgoing transitions go to A29. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003]
- The outgoing transitions of A26, A27 and A28 before went to A29, A28, A27 and others; in the later window these activities are almost absent, so their outgoing transitions are based on only 3 traces each. [DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- Relational evidence: A26, A27 and A28 co-occurred with each other and with A29, A44 and A45 in almost all traces before (co-occurrence ≈ 1.0). In the later window, these co-occurrences drop to about 0.01–0.015. [REL036, REL037, REL042, REL038, REL039, REL040, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL047, REL048, REL049]
- A19, A20 and A21 now co-occur with A29 in about 30–37.5% of traces, and when they do, A19/A20/A21 precede A29 (A_before_B ≈ 0.3). [REL018, REL025, REL032]
- A19, A20 and A21 also co-occur with A44, but in the opposite order (A44 before them). [REL019, REL026, REL033]
- Position: A19, A20 and A21 now appear at a median position around 0.36, similar to A29's median around 0.39, whereas before they were too rare to have a stable position. [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS007]
- A29's position shifted slightly earlier (mean from 0.437 to 0.400). [POS007]
- A44's position shifted slightly later (mean from 0.309 to 0.330). [POS008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change in the core path of the process: activities A26, A27 and A28, which were executed in almost every trace in the earlier window, are almost never executed in the later window, while activities A19, A20 and A21, which were nearly absent before, are now executed in a substantial share of traces and lead to A29. This is supported by the consistent drop in participation of A26/A27/A28, the rise of A19/A20/A21, the change in their outgoing transitions to A29, and the relational co-occurrence patterns. The screening count (81 items vs 0.89 expected by chance) rules out a chance artifact. The evidence cannot rule out that the new activities are optional alternatives rather than a full replacement, since they appear in only about 30–37% of traces, while A29 remains in all traces.

Other differences: A10 participation increased from about 13.5% to 22.5%. [OCC001] The positions of A29 and A44 shifted slightly, but these are minor. [POS007, POS008]
